---
title: "Course Admin"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - language-switch.html
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #admin-panel h3 { color: #1a4d1a; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 2rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }

  #schedule-table, #stats-table {
    width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 0.5rem;
  }
  #schedule-table th, #stats-table th {
    background: #1a4d1a; color: white; padding: 10px 16px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700;
  }
  #schedule-table td, #stats-table td {
    padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0; vertical-align: middle;
  }
  #schedule-table tr:hover, #stats-table tr:hover { background: #f8f9fa; }

  .toggle-btn {
    border: none; border-radius: 50px; padding: 6px 18px; font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.82rem; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s;
  }
  .toggle-btn:hover { opacity: 0.8; }
  .btn-unlocked { background: #a8d5a2; color: #1a4d1a; }
  .btn-locked   { background: #e0e0e0; color: #555; }

  .progress-mini {
    background: #e9ecef; border-radius: 50px; height: 20px;
    min-width: 120px; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .progress-mini div {
    background: #a8d5a2; color: #1a4d1a; font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 800; height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center;
    padding-left: 8px; border-radius: 50px; min-width: 32px;
  }

  #admin-message {
    text-align: center; padding: 60px 20px;
    background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 16px; margin-top: 2rem;
  }
  #admin-message h3 { color: #1a4d1a; font-weight: 800; }

  .admin-login-btn {
    background: #1a4d1a; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 50px;
    font-weight: 800; padding: 12px 36px; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 1rem;
  }
  .admin-login-btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

  .stat-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a4d1a, #2d7a2d);
    color: white; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 28px;
    display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .stat-card .number { font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; }
  .stat-card .label  { font-size: 0.9rem; opacity: 0.85; margin-top: 4px; }
</style>

<!-- Login / access denied message – visible by default while loading -->
<div id="admin-message">
  <h3>⏳ Loading…</h3>
</div>

<!-- Admin panel (shown only to admins) -->
<div id="admin-panel" style="display:none;">

  <h3>🔓 Week Access Control</h3>
  <p style="color:#555;">Click a button to toggle access. Changes take effect immediately for all students.</p>
  <table id="schedule-table">
    <thead><tr><th>Week</th><th>Content</th><th>Exercises</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody id="schedule-body"></tbody>
  </table>

  <h3>📊 Student Progress</h3>
  <div id="stats-area"><p style="color:#888;">Loading…</p></div>

</div>

<script>
const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://hpyezixseggwnrpepbhx.supabase.co';
const SUPABASE_KEY = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6ImhweWV6aXhzZWdnd25ycGVwYmh4Iiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3NzY4MTUzMDgsImV4cCI6MjA5MjM5MTMwOH0.HGcrv7-I07yFES2qBRhXf1j3UCbfMb8PwlWkQjY6NYs';

// ── Add GitHub usernames of admins here ──
const ADMINS = ['lisaduttenhoefer'];

const WEEK_LABELS = {
  1:'Week 1: Basic Data Structures',
  2:'Week 2: Data Cleanup & Visualisation',
  3:'Week 3', 4:'Week 4', 5:'Week 5',
  6:'Week 6', 7:'Week 7', 8:'Week 8', 9:'Week 9'
};

let sbClient;

// ── Entry point ──
function init() {
  if (typeof supabase === 'undefined') { setTimeout(init, 100); return; }
  try {
    sbClient = supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);
  } catch(e) {
    showMessage('❌ Error', 'Could not connect to Supabase: ' + e.message, '');
    return;
  }
  sbClient.auth.getSession()
    .then(({ data, error }) => {
      if (error) { showMessage('❌ Auth Error', error.message, ''); return; }
      const session = data?.session;
      if (!session) {
        showMessage(
          '🔐 Admin Login',
          'Please log in with the admin GitHub account to continue.',
          '<button class="admin-login-btn" onclick="sbLogin()">Login with GitHub</button>'
        );
        return;
      }
      const username = session.user.user_metadata?.user_name || '';
      if (!ADMINS.includes(username)) {
        showMessage('⛔ Access Denied', `Your account (<strong>${username}</strong>) is not an admin.`, '');
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('admin-message').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('admin-panel').style.display = 'block';
      loadSchedule();
      loadStats();
    })
    .catch(e => showMessage('❌ Error', e.message, ''));
}

function showMessage(title, body, extra) {
  const el = document.getElementById('admin-message');
  el.style.display = 'block';
  el.innerHTML = `<h3>${title}</h3><p style="color:#555;">${body}</p>${extra}`;
}

// ── Schedule table ──
async function loadSchedule() {
  const { data } = await sbClient.from('course_schedule').select('*').order('week');
  renderSchedule(data || []);
}

function renderSchedule(rows) {
  document.getElementById('schedule-body').innerHTML = rows.map(row => `
    <tr>
      <td style="font-weight:700;">${WEEK_LABELS[row.week] || 'Week ' + row.week}</td>
      <td>
        <button class="toggle-btn ${row.content_unlocked ? 'btn-unlocked' : 'btn-locked'}"
                onclick="toggle(${row.week}, 'content_unlocked', ${!row.content_unlocked})">
          ${row.content_unlocked ? '✅ Unlocked' : '🔒 Locked'}
        </button>
      </td>
      <td>
        <button class="toggle-btn ${row.exercises_unlocked ? 'btn-unlocked' : 'btn-locked'}"
                onclick="toggle(${row.week}, 'exercises_unlocked', ${!row.exercises_unlocked})">
          ${row.exercises_unlocked ? '✅ Unlocked' : '🔒 Locked'}
        </button>
      </td>
    </tr>
  `).join('');
}

async function toggle(week, field, newValue) {
  await sbClient.from('course_schedule').update({ [field]: newValue }).eq('week', week);
  loadSchedule();
}

// ── Progress stats ──
async function loadStats() {
  const { data, error } = await sbClient.rpc('get_course_stats');
  const area = document.getElementById('stats-area');
  if (error || !data) {
    area.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">No student data yet.</p>';
    return;
  }

  const total  = data.total_students || 0;
  const byWeek = data.by_week || [];

  const weekRows = byWeek.map(w => {
    const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round(w.students_active / total * 100) : 0;
    return `<tr>
      <td style="font-weight:700;">${WEEK_LABELS[w.week_num] || 'Week ' + w.week_num}</td>
      <td>${w.students_active} / ${total}</td>
      <td>
        <div class="progress-mini">
          <div style="width:${pct}%">${pct}%</div>
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');

  area.innerHTML = `
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="number">${total}</div>
      <div class="label">students registered</div>
    </div>
    <table id="stats-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Week</th><th>Students active</th><th>% of class</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${weekRows || '<tr><td colspan="3" style="color:#888;">No activity yet.</td></tr>'}</tbody>
    </table>
  `;
}

async function sbLogin() {
  await sbClient.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    provider: 'github',
    options: { redirectTo: window.location.href }
  });
}

// Wait for DOM + Supabase, then start
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
} else {
  init();
}
</script>
```
